note: Preseason status. Week 1 is 2026-09-09, so gameday inactive lists do not exist yet; these are camp designations. Statuses read directly off the league's own Yahoo pages are marked source 'yahoo'. Items from reporting are marked 'news' and are the ones most worth re-checking before you draft, since camp status moves daily. nflverse roster data was deliberately not used here: it lists Ricky Pearsall as active while Yahoo has him on IR, so it is not reliable for designations this time of year.

levels.questionable: Tagged Q. In late August this is usually minor and often clears.
levels.pup: Physically Unable to Perform. Misses at least the first four games if he opens the season on it.
levels.out: On IR or otherwise ruled out.

Zach Charbonnet.detail: Still on PUP after an ACL tear; a Week 1 return is considered unlikely

Tucker Kraft.detail: Off PUP and ramping up after a torn ACL; has a shot at Week 1

George Kittle.detail: Activated off PUP, ahead of schedule on the Achilles; legitimate chance at Week 1

Malik Nabers.detail: Limited in 11-on-11 without a non-contact jersey; on track for Week 1
